news.text: 🇵🇹‼️ "Attention on #Varela: for €30/35M, #Monza would seek him in January. We've told you about the meetings with #Napoli, the contacts with #Juventus, #Inter went to scout him more with an eye toward summer. At the moment, we still can't speak of agreements or advanced talks. Let's see if other clubs also enter this conversation, which is wide open."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🤩🧐 "#BrunoFernandes, the contract extension announced by #ManchesterUnited does not represent a long-term stay, but rather financial protection to avoid losing him on a free transfer. Talks over a new deal are on hold at his own request: he first wants to understand what the club's future and project will be. He could therefore leave at the end of the season: there is a €65M release clause, but the price could be even lower."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇳🇱❌ "On the #Taylor-#Juventus front: the Dutchman is very happy at #Lazio and is not showing any intention of leaving the club or evaluating other offers. Relations are excellent and no changes are expected in January. At the moment, therefore, the potential bianconero interest is a lead to set aside."[Fabrizio Romano - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇮🇹🤔 "If #Juventus were to sign another center-forward in January, #Ekhator would risk being squeezed out and ending up on the fringes of the project. At that point, he could leave on loan to find greater playing time. Three clubs have already inquired about him: #Genoa, #Sassuolo and #Parma."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

THE GOALS ARE THERENOW THE STRIKER#Spalletti has multiplied #Juve's attacking solutions: already 16 different goalscorers. While waiting for #Yildiz and the winter reinforcement. In Europe, the average is even higher at 3 goals per game. Even #Ekhator has opened his account, but he is doubtful for #Como: today is a decisive fitness test (the same goes for #Nico). For January, the strategy does not change: #Sørloth remains the favorite despite the injury.[Front Page TuttoSport]
